sourceNotes: Local inspected references: output/questrom-reference-front.jpg and output/questrom-reference-wide.jpg
Existing shallow office-window apertures and five authored entry-bay axes remain unchanged. No new door opening, interior, stairs or geography.
Pressure-cap sections, hardware sizes and the 2.9 m door/transom split are construction approximations, not an as-built survey.
Only the five old box handles are replaced. Every other source face is protected outside the builder's explicit bounded bevel selections.

limitations: Source model massing, approximate window/door geometry, source DEM and collision remain unchanged; not a new measured/as-built reconstruction.
Reference photo supports thin frame profiles, door/transom construction and pull hardware. Exact section sizes and the new 2.9m door head are authored estimates.
Only the two dark entrance bases widen 6 mm on each side to resolve source coplanar side faces; this thin wrap is authored, not surveyed. Heights/depths and all other roofs are unchanged.
Stone reuses the baked continuous concrete/mineral microtexture, preserving modeled large-panel joints without adding fictional small masonry bonds.
Opaque exterior glass uses the reviewed .2 linear tint/.16 roughness approach and requires runtime neighborhood reflection; no interior or transmission.
Canvas entrance inscription is excluded from this asset and must remain in the runtime extras group.
